name: Milk the Cow
review:
A cheerful farmyard on a 5x5 cluster grid with a free spins bonus. The presentation is relaxed and cartoony.

Don't let that fool you: behind the pastures sits high volatility and a 5,000x cap, so the free spins carry most of the game's value. The published RTP is 94.17%, below average. Fun to look at, but try it in demo before playing for real.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
